name: TagsInput
summary: Wrapping chip-row tag entry. Comma OR Enter commits; Backspace on empty draft removes last chip; shell flexes to multi-line when chips wrap.

onChange.description: Fires with the next tag-array on add or remove.

max.description: Soft cap on tag count. UI shows '+N more' past this and refuses to add more.

name.description: Form field name. Submitted as a comma-joined string.

keyboard: Tab — focus the field (lands on the draft input)
Enter or Comma — commit draft as a new tag
Backspace on empty draft — remove the last tag (announced)
Click the X on a chip — remove that chip
rules: Each chip's close button has aria-label='Remove {tag}'.
Backspace-removes-last fires a polite live-region announcement so AT users hear the removal.
Commit on blur — don't drop a half-typed tag.
Duplicate add is a silent no-op with subtle visual feedback (chip flashes briefly).

do: Commit on both Enter AND Comma — the two most common keys.
Commit on blur as well; don't drop a half-typed tag.
Trim whitespace and skip empty / duplicate tags silently.
Cap rendered chips and show '+N more' for dense tables.
dont: Don't auto-format casing — preserve user input.
Don't allow commas-as-separator AND commas-in-tag in the same field without a clear UX hint.

changelog.note: Initial release. Promotes the v0.6 audit-dashboard primitive in inputs.tsx to a dedicated contract. Wrap-flex shell, Comma + Enter commit, Backspace-removes-last, blur commits.
